items.information:
## Southern Ontario Summer 2023 Series

We are running three competitions ([Newmarket](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SOSNewmarket2023), [Oshawa](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SOSOshawa2023), and [Waterloo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SOSWaterloo2023)) as part of the Southern Ontario Summer 2023 Series. All three competitions are happening on the same day with nearly identical schedules. Please register for the competition that is nearest to you.

You will only be able to compete in *one* of these three competitions. Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.

## Registration Reminders

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

## Mailing List

We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community.

## Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information:
* Los **socios de la AMS** (Asociación Madrileña) recibirán un **descuento del 25%**. Puedes hacerte socio de la AMS [aquí](https://www.speedcubingmadrid.org/association/adhesion).
* Los **socios de la AES** (Asociación Española) recibirán un **descuento del 15%**. Puedes hacerte socio de la AES [aquí](https://speedcubingspain.org/register/).
* Los socios de ambas asociaciones reciben un **descuento del 25%**, i.e., los descuentos no son acumulables.

Para los descuentos, el pago se debe hacer como todos los competidores y tras la competición se devolverá el importe de los descuentos.

-----

* The **AMS members** (Madrid Association) will receive a **25% discount**. You can become a member of the AMS [here](https://www.speedcubingmadrid.org/association/adhesion).
* The **AES members** (Spanish Association) will receive a **15% discount**. You can become a member of the AES [here](https://speedcubingspain.org/register/).
* Members from both associations will receive a **25% discount**, i.e., discounts do not stack.

For discounts, the payment must be made as all other competitors and after the competition the discounts will be returned.

Welcome to Sotenäs Summer Solving 2023! 

If you want a competition on the warm and beautiful west coast of Sweden, we welcome you to Hunnebostrand this summer! As always, all competitors are welcome, regardless of whether you solve the cube in five minutes or five seconds.
